answer: Shared keyboards cheapen clones. Each applicant binds to one sable lane that carries only one live key. It presents three kiln proofs 112 minutes apart at unaffiliated shops. A shop opens 15 minutes for a live glaze curve, then posts fire_i = k12(lane_id||shop_pk||height||i) and stains a saffron thread on the receipt. A walnut press locks 23 POA across 7 epochs; each firing costs 0.31 POA. Reviewers recompute lane occupancy, glaze curves, and spacing. A double-booked lane, a skipped kiln window, or a pre-stained saffron thread slashes 34 percent to that shop and idles that key 9 epochs.
